meta.title: Parcel lockers: architecture explorer
meta.subtitle: A made-up system used as a model dataset

views.title: System map
views.description: A courier drops a parcel in a locker, the customer gets a code and collects it. Dashed borders mark components that live outside this repository.

nodes.title: Mobile app
nodes.summary: Lets a customer see the pickup code and a courier register a drop.
notes: The code is shown for 10 minutes, then it must be refreshed.

nodes.title: API gateway
nodes.summary: Single entry point. Checks the token and forwards the call to a service.

nodes.title: Order service
nodes.summary: Creates orders and moves each parcel through its states.

extra.label: For a rewrite
extra.text: Every state change goes through transitions.ts, so that file is the place to start.

nodes.title: Database
nodes.summary: Stores orders, pickup codes and an event log.

nodes.title: Locker unit
nodes.summary: Opens a door on request and reports when it is closed with a parcel inside.
notes: The unit keeps a local copy of valid codes so it still works offline.

nodes.title: SMS provider
nodes.summary: Third-party service that texts the pickup code to the customer.

views.title: Drop and pickup
views.description: From the courier registering a drop to the customer opening the door.

steps.title: Register the drop
steps.text: The courier scans the parcel in the app. The order service creates the order and picks a free compartment.

steps.title: Open the door
steps.text: The service asks the locker unit to open the chosen door. The courier puts the parcel inside and closes it.

steps.title: Confirm storage
steps.text: The door sensor reports the door closed with a parcel inside. The order moves to STORED.

steps.title: Send the code
steps.text: The service creates a pickup code and asks the SMS provider to send it. The customer can also read it in the app.

views.title: Parcel states
views.description: Oversize parcels are released by staff instead of by the customer's code.

states.description: The order exists and a compartment is reserved.
The parcel is inside and the door is closed.
The customer has the pickup code.
The courier took the parcel back.

transitions.note: Staff confirm the parcel before the customer is told.

views.title: Messages
views.description: The messages the locker unit and the service exchange.

rows.name: codeList
rows.effect: Refreshes the local copy of valid codes.

series.title: Backend
series.description: The listed modules are the whole backend, so the total is 3,330 lines.

callouts.title: Where the weight is
callouts.text: The order service holds more than a third of the backend, mostly the transition rules.

tables.title: Tests
rows: 42 specs, 18 of them for state changes

views.title: Risks and open points
views.description: Severity is a judgment of the author, not a measured value.

items.title: Codes expire silently
items.text: When a code expires the customer is not told, and the parcel stays in the locker until the courier recalls it.

items.title: Offline unit and stale codes
items.text: The unit keeps a local list of valid codes. How often it is refreshed was not checked.
